summary: Cloud identity tag synchronization anomaly causing intermittent role binding mismatches across AWS accounts
description:
Issue summary: Our tag-sync automation (tag-syncer) intermittently fails to propagate updated 'env' and 'owner' tags to a subset of AWS accounts. This results in IAM role condition mismatches during Dedicated/Dedicated-provisioner runs and causes permission denied errors for the deployer service account.

Impact: Blocking provisioning and CI-based environment bootstrap for a small number of Dedicated account creations. Failure rate ~4% on recent runs; affects internal infra-onboarding and some private deploy customer flows. Not customer-facing directly yet but prevents automated onboarding of Dedicated pools.

Environment: prod us-east; affected regions observed in us-east-1 and us-west-2 account sets. Tag-syncer version: 1.12.3 (deployed to infra-provisioner cluster).

Steps to reproduce: 
1) Trigger dedicated account onboarding via infra-provisioner CI pipeline (CI job: infra/onboard/dedicated).
2) Observe pipeline fail at 'attach-role-bindings' step with error 'Condition check failed: aws:PrincipalTag/env mismatch' in deployer logs.
3) Inspect AWS console or call STS:GetCallerIdentity with role ARN and validate tags on resource and service account.
4) Re-run tag-syncer manually; some accounts show tags applied after retry, others require manual reconcile.

Observed behavior: Role assume_chains evaluate condition keys against missing or stale tags; IAM denies AssumeRole even though policy exists. The tag-syncer logs show a mix of 200 and 500 responses from downstream account API calls during the same run.

Expected behavior: Tag updates should consistently reach all target accounts within the pipeline's run window; CI should continue only after reconciliation completes successfully.

Temporary mitigation: Added an infra-provisioner retry loop (3 retries, 30s backoff) around attach-role-bindings; added alert rule for 'tag-syncer:failed-ops > 0' to #infra-ops. Manual reconciliation script exists (scripts/reconcile-tags.sh) for urgent unblocks.
investigation_notes:
Summary of findings: reproducible when pipeline spike coincides with downstream account API 429/500s. Hypothesis A: tag-syncer does not honor eventual-consistency delays and assumes immediate tag application; race leads to condition checks failing. Hypothesis B: some target accounts have a throttling policy which returns 200 with partial success; tag-syncer treats as success.

What we looked at: tag-syncer logs (K8s pod logs) for three failing runs; CloudTrail in a sample affected account (account-arn: 111222333444) shows PutResourceTag events succeeded but Tag-on-resource read via GET returned previous state for ~12s. STS logs show AssumeRole failures with Condition mismatch. No suspicious IAM deny policies found.

Short experiments: 1) Added a 15s wait+verify loop after tagging — reduces failures in small sample. 2) Retried tagging until GET confirmed tags present — success in all tests. 3) Ran tag-syncer with stricter HTTP retry/backoff — failure rate dropped from 4% to 0.3% in our test cluster.

Next steps: 1) Enhance tag-syncer to confirm tags via idempotent GET and escalate transient failures instead of returning success. 2) Increase default backoff and add exponential jitter on 5xx/429. 3) Add preflight check in infra-provisioner that validates required principal tags before assume-role step. 4) Plan rollout of tag-syncer 1.12.4 with these fixes and coordinate with infra oncall for deployment window.
steps_taken:
- Deployed temporary retry wrapper in infra-provisioner pipeline.
- Created alert in PagerDuty via #infra-ops channel.
- Ran manual reconcile script on three affected accounts; verified onboarding completion.
- Reproduced failure locally and validated mitigation reduces rate.
- Opened PR to tag-syncer to add GET-confirmation and better backoff (see related PR).
comments: Diego Martinez (SRE): Noticed higher 5xx spike on tag-syncer pod logs during 03/12 04:00 UTC window. Instrumented client to emit upstream error codes — seeing intermittent 502 from account-proxy in front of target accounts.
Lina Cho (Infra): Confirmed manual reconcile worked for customer-simulated account in us-west-2. Suggest we gate onboarding on tag-confirmation to avoid partial state.

Aisha Kapoor (Reporter): Temporarily set infra-provisioner to break on first missing tag to force manual review; this avoids silent failures but increases toil. Seeking automated fix for production rollout.
Diego Martinez (SRE): Will schedule tag-syncer 1.12.4 deploy in next maintenance window with feature flags disabled at first. Post-deploy we'll run full onboard regression against 50 accounts.
resolution: Work in progress: short-term retry wrapper and manual reconcile in place. Target release tag-syncer 1.12.4 to add confirmation and improved backoff. Post-deploy validation plan prepared.
notes_for_followup:
- Add a per-account success metric for tag propagation latency.
- Update runbook with 'verify-tags' step and incident playbook for tag propagation failures.
- Consider moving tag propagation to a strong-consistency orchestration step for critical role bindings.
